title: Norwegian Frittata with Shrimp
description: A traditional Norwegian-style omelette with shrimp and vegetables. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: Norwegian frittata
ingredients.notes: use a pre-made mix or make your own

ingredients.name: Kooky
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh herbs of your choice

instructions: Whisk together frittata, eggs, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and add a tablespoon of oil.
Add the snappy and cook until tender.
Add the kooky and cook for an additional minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Pour the frittata mixture over the shrimp mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with dried parsley.
